positions.title: Automation
positions.description: New product development, Natural Language Processing, Azure based cloud solution, Build, test and deployment automation.

positions.title: Director of Software Engineering
positions.description:
Leading development team that develops and enhances SAS population health platform for numerous portals used by clinicians, providers and participants for improvement of overall health.

Our team played a critical role in a 3 year project to replace the population health engine that involved multiple teams and went to production with no issues thanks to our use of dark features.

We have fully automated CI/CD with fully traceable code changes using Azure DevOps.

Our team has implemented EHR integration with Athena, Allscripts Professional and Allscripts Touchworks that has been rolled out to 44 different practices utilizing HL7 v3 & custom APIs.  We are currently working on FHIR integrations.
We migrated our solution to Azure and work on reducing cost hosting costs.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
Leading teams that enhance and support:
- Content and Knowledge Management applications (Sitecore,Alfresco)
- Intranet
- Corporate Workflow Applications
- Forms and Outputs Applications

positions.title: Integration of Practice Management and EMR data
positions.description:
-Reverse-engineered and documented existing referral and claim number processes
-Designed and developed new referral interfaces utilizing web services following existing design patterns
-Designed and developed new claim number interface utilizing existing pattern of Pearl, Shell Script, Oracle Packages matching patient and case data to claim numbers and loading data back to 16 billing databases
-Designed and developed provider note interfaces pulling data from over 100 databases following existing design patterns
-Provided design assistance on ICD10 project
-Provided design and development assistance on interface project with Allscripts Enterprise EMR

positions.title: Electronic Medical Record implementation
positions.description:
-Provided feedback  on Allscripts SOW
-Led the new EMR team members through on-boarding process to get them productive as part of --Concentra EMR team in short period of time.
-Prepared various documentation and summary reports used for design decisions used by business EMR leadership to make Allscripts Enterprise design decisions.
-Wrote number of summary trending reports in preparation phase of EMR building process to help business leaders make fact based decisions.
-Wrote EMR Infrastructure requirements corresponding to the Allscripts Enterprise design decisions  to make sure the project could be success.
-Documented the delivery process from build through QA to production

positions.title: Development Manager
positions.description:
-Led a team of engineers in the development and support of applications that are used for practice management of Concentra’s health-care clinics and billing operations.
-Led an effort to upgrade existing core applications from PowerBuilder 9 to PowerBuilder 11.5
-Implemented automated build process
-Ensured effective team utilization of SDLC process
-Implemented automated monitoring tools over AutoCommunication software that generates over 12 million reports yearly and delivers them via fax and/or email
-Led the design, development, Implementation and support of a new Revenue Transaction Management which classifies over 3 million AR related transactions within 5 minutes.
-Led the design, development, Implementation and support of new GL interface to Oracle Financials 
-Implemented Development Architect tools from PowerDesigner utilized  to perform impact  analysis on large heterogeneous systems.
-Developed a web service talking to Oracle Financials

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
-Gathered business requirements and communicated with outsourced off-shore development team to ensure the requirement fulfillment
-Gathered data via web crawling tools Velocityscape Web Scraper and WatiN
-Verified existing data against YellowPages and Google
-Created automated data cleansing processes
-Imported data into existing applications
-Setup clients with database backups and restores
-Setup eTL to refresh non-production environments with production data daily
-Database tuning and performance improvements

positions.title: Development Manager
positions.description:
-Provided technical leadership to the development team for the core admissions, billing and auto-communication applications written in PowerBuilder 9 with Sybase Enterprise database
-Worked with analysts, clients and testers to fully understand the business requirements
-Designed and reviewed enhancements made to the core applications
-Designed and written tools assisting the team in monitoring the applications the team was supporting
-Ensured the team was following the SDLC process

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Contracted for Concentra
-Developed and supported the core admissions and auto-communication applications written in -PowerBuilder 9 with Sybase Enterprise database
-Worked on interface improvements loading data into Sybase ASE DBs via shell scripts
-Worked with analysts, clients and testers to fully understand the business requirements

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
-Worked on Carillon ERP product to small and middle-sized clients.  Carillon Financials, is a robust real time accounting package, which includes Accounts Payable, Account Receivable, General Ledger, Order Entry, PDA Order Entry, Purchase Order, Inventory, Fixed Assets, Contacts, Job Cost, Time & Billing, Payroll, Production Order, Financial Desktop, Executive Desktop, Mail and Web Pack modules.  Other modules involve customizable functionality with which to implement business rules per the individual client’s needs.  All modules are fully integrated.  This financial package also includes high-level security and up to-the-minute information provision.
-Developed financial software in PowerBuider 10 (9,8,7,and 6.5) utilizing all types of datawindows, user objects, tree views, and OLE functionality with Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Outlook, Xmap.
-Designed synchronization procedure between MS SQL Server consolidated database and ASA remote databases using MobiLink and written synchronization scripts.
-Installed and configured MS SQL server, reporting services and defined cubes per customer requirements
-Designed and developed PDA application including creation of contacts, customers, orders, conflict resolution and utilizing POOM to create and modify Pocket contacts and calendar.
-Designed of software and database modifications based on client’s business needs using object-oriented methodologies.
-Led and trained PowerBuilder programmers in meeting client commitments
Installed software and databases for clients and trained users
-Provided support for clients and resolved performance issues
-Prepared and delivered new version releases through Pettit methodology which included design, construction, quality assurance, and delivery.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
-Performed system enhancements to Carillon Financials application based on the design by senior consultant using PowerBuilder 5.3 menu, window, datawindow and user object painters.
-Created triggers, stored procedures, unions, inner and outer joined SQL statements across multiple databases: Oracle, Sybase/Microsoft SQL Server and Adaptive Server Anywhere (system included 550+ database tables).
